description: In combination with `pdClim-control`, quantifies hydrogen (H2) effective radiative forcing (ERF) relative to a present-day base state. Same as `pdClim-control`, except the effects of H2 on CH4 and O3 chemistry use pre-industrial (1850) values. Requires models that include H2 emissions; the setup should be coordinated with the AerChemMIP2 co-chairs.
